segments.title: mind as the only creator

spans.eng: all the living beings of the universe
if somehow you could stop all minds
mind and what comes along with it

spans.tib: las kyang sems la brten pa
spans.eng: karma itself depends on the mind

spans.tib: sa bcu par byed pa po dang tshor ba po med pa zhes gsungs pa
spans.eng: the statement from the Sutra of the Ten Levels, where it says that there is no great master of all things, and no great maker of all things

spans.tib: byed pa po gzhan 'gog par bstan la
spans.eng: the point is that there is no other creator of things than the mind itself.

segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment proposed independently by Codex (English-first). Suppled modal and causal hinges remain unwrapped.
